Survey.title: Survey
Survey.description: A user-submitted suggestion or feature request for Ball Typing.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitter.

authorName.description: Display name entered by the player.

SurveyQuota.title: SurveyQuota
SurveyQuota.description: Per-user daily JST survey submission counter enforcing a strict limit of 3 per day.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this quota record.

year.description: JST year of the last submission.

month.description: JST month of the last submission.

day.description: JST day of the last submission.

count.description: Number of surveys submitted on this JST date (1 to 3).

lastSurveyId.description: Document ID of the survey created in this atomic batch.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest submission.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

/surveys/{surveyId}.description: Feature request surveys submitted by authenticated players (readable only by admins).

/surveyQuotas/{userId}.description: Server-time-enforced daily quota tracker limiting each user to 3 surveys per JST day.

/admins/{userId}.description: Admin role documents readable only by the owning admin or existing admins.
